field.description: Bar field: open, high, low, or close (default close). Ignored at `lookback: 0` (live ticker). At `lookback >= 1` returns this OHLC field of bar N back — enables wick/rejection patterns (e.g. high pierced a level then close reclaimed).

lookback.description: How many bars back to look. 0 = latest bar, 1 = one bar ago, etc. Max 20.

name.description: Indicator name. One of: SMA20, SMA50, EMA, RSI, ADX, MACD, BBANDS, ATR, ATR_PCT, VWAP, OBV, OBV_CHANGE, LAST_DAY_HIGH, LAST_DAY_LOW, LAST_WEEK_HIGH, LAST_WEEK_LOW, SWING_HIGH, SWING_LOW, BOS, CHOCH, DISPLACEMENT, VOLUME_PROFILE, DEALING_RANGE.

field.description: Sub-field for composite indicators: MACD uses signal/histogram, BBANDS uses upper/middle/lower, VOLUME_PROFILE uses poc/vah/val, DEALING_RANGE uses equilibrium/premium_pct. Use value for scalar indicators.

wing.description: Pivot wing for SWING_HIGH/SWING_LOW/BOS/CHOCH/DEALING_RANGE: bars required on each side to confirm a pivot. Default 3. Smaller (1–2) = short-term structure, larger (4–10) = major swings only.

atrMult.description: ATR(14) multiplier for DISPLACEMENT: bar range must exceed atrMult × ATR to count as displacement. Default 1.5.

lookbackBars.description: Rolling window length for VOLUME_PROFILE (bars ending at the current closed bar). Default 48. Must fit the entry-rules indicator window (≤100).

params.description: Optional indicator parameters (e.g. swing pivot wing, VOLUME_PROFILE lookbackBars). Empty object = defaults.

zoneType.description: fvg_bull/fvg_bear = 3-candle fair value gap (imbalance). ob_bull/ob_bear = last opposite-close candle before a displacement bar (order block).

state.description: Which zones to consider: open = untouched, tapped = wick entered but no close through, mitigated = closed beyond the far edge. Default open.

field.description: Zone price level: top or bottom edge, or mid (midpoint — the FVG 'consequent encroachment'). Default mid.

usedTechnicalAnalysisIndicators.description: Indicators that justify this entry (one of: SMA20, SMA50, EMA, RSI, ADX, MACD, BBANDS, ATR, ATR_PCT, VWAP, OBV, OBV_CHANGE, LAST_DAY_HIGH, LAST_DAY_LOW, LAST_WEEK_HIGH, LAST_WEEK_LOW, SWING_HIGH, SWING_LOW, BOS, CHOCH, DISPLACEMENT, VOLUME_PROFILE, DEALING_RANGE) — use [] when none. Never list zone types (fvg_bull, fvg_bear, ob_bull, ob_bear); those belong on zone operands.

position.description: Full replace of rules.position (not a merge). Every key required. usdAmount XOR balancePercent (unused = 0). orderType = market|limit. limitPrice + expiresInMinutes = number | null (null unless limit). usedTechnicalAnalysisIndicators = string[] ([] if none; never zone types).

a.description: First input — a primitive operand (price, indicator, or constant). No nesting.

b.description: Second input — a primitive operand (price, indicator, or constant). No nesting.

source.description: Operand resolved at rule-fire time (latest fully closed bar). Any indicator, price field, or derived expression.

op.description: multiply = resolved(source) × value; add = resolved(source) + value.

value.description: Multiplier or addend applied after resolving source.

minPercentage.description: Floor on the resolved 0–100 distance after op. Null disables.

maxPercentage.description: Ceiling on the resolved 0–100 distance after op. Null disables.

fallbackPercentage.description: Fixed 0–100 distance used when source resolves null (indicator warmup).

stopLossPercentage.description: Stop-loss distance from entry on the 0–100 scale, or a dynamic expression resolved at fire time. 0 disables SL.

takeProfitPercentage.description: Take-profit distance from entry on the 0–100 scale, or a dynamic expression resolved at fire time.

pricePercentage.description: Signed decimal move from entry (-1 to 1). Percent as fraction: -0.005 = -0.5%, 0.03 = +3%. Not the 0–100 scale used by stopLossPercentage.

exitAmountFraction.description: Fraction of the remaining position to liquidate when this level is hit

partialExitsAt.description: Ladder of partial exits. Null means no partial exits.

trail.description: Trail config: [fire, extend]. Null disables. extend > 0 chains (re-arm after each bump); extend = 0 locks SL at the fire price once then clears. fire = fraction of current TP distance (0–1 exclusive); extend = TP multiplier add-on (0 = fire-price lock one-shot).

breakevenAfterMinutes.description: Soft TTL: minutes after open at which the engine intervenes. If the trade is in profit, it closes at market to lock in the gain. If underwater, SL moves to break-even. Null disables.

maxHoldMinutes.description: Hard TTL: force close at market after this many minutes regardless of PnL. Null disables.

op.description: Comparison operator. crosses_above/crosses_below require previous bar context.

startUtc.description: Window start, inclusive (e.g. "09:30" for the New York killzone open).

endUtc.description: Window end, exclusive. Earlier than startUtc = overnight window (e.g. "02:00" with start "22:00"). Equal to startUtc = always in window.

timeframeMinutes.description: Chart timeframe whose latest closed bar provides the clock. Use 5 or 15 for killzone precision.

days.description: Allowed UTC weekdays (e.g. omit "fri" to skip Friday).

timeframeMinutes.description: Chart timeframe whose latest closed bar provides the clock. Use 5 or 15 for precision.

signalExit.description: Optional indicator-based exit: closes the position at market when these conditions fire (evaluated on the same cadence as entries). Same condition shape as entry blocks. Use for mean-reversion targets (e.g. close crosses VWAP) or thesis-invalidation exits instead of relying only on fixed TP. Null disables.

exit.description: Full replace of rules.exit (not a merge). Every key required — null disables: stopLossPercentage + takeProfitPercentage = 0–100 number OR {source,op,value,fallbackPercentage,minPercentage,maxPercentage}; partialExitsAt = [{pricePercentage, exitAmountFraction}] | null (pricePercentage is a decimal fraction: 0.03 = +3%, NOT the 0–100 SL/TP scale); trail = [fire, extend] | null (fire in (0,1), extend >= 0; NOT {fire,extend}); breakevenAfterMinutes + maxHoldMinutes = number | null; signalExit = {long, short} condition arrays | null. Cooldown lives on the rules root (op=patch_cooldown), not here.

tools.name: get_backtest
tools.description: Cache-or-run one sim for an @R# + window, then return Score, trade count, PnL, drawdown, and bounded stats for one run. Numbers only — no BenAwf assessment LLM; you analyze. Same @R# + window → cached @B# (identical stats; follow the comment). After any mutate pass that result's dsl_ref. If you changed rules behind the same R#/draft, or suspect a stale cached @B#, pass force:true to force a fresh sim — never extrapolate from a cached B# of a different rules state.

force.description: Skip the cache and force a fresh sim for this @R# + window. Use after any rule change on the same R#/draft, or whenever a cached B# is suspect.

config.description: Window + capital. Omit to reuse the previous run's window. Do not send empty strings or zeros.
